comment: Cancels the latest transfer of an object as its requester; expects 200 01000, clientCancelled. The cleanup of a case that leaves a transfer pending, which the server approves minutes later and queues messages then.

registrar.comment: The slot of the registrar that requested the transfer, a or b.

collection.comment: The collection of the object: contacts, domainNames or planets.

id.comment: The id or name of the object.
